name: Lifeboat
summary: Back up, restore and clone your whole Omarchy to your Google Drive

featured.headline: Your whole Omarchy, saved.
featured.tagline: Back up Hermes, your themes, keybindings, dotfiles, SSH keys and every installed app to your own Google Drive, locked with a passphrase only you know. Restore after a disaster, or clone your setup onto a new computer.

features.title: Your whole setup in one backup
features.body: Hermes (memory, skills, keys), your Omarchy desktop and theme, keybindings, dotfiles, SSH keys and the list of every app you installed. Add any extra folders you like.

features.title: Locked with your passphrase
features.body: Encrypted on your computer with AES-256 before anything is uploaded. Only your passphrase opens it. Not Google, not us.

features.title: Your Google Drive, privately
features.body: Saved to a hidden Lifeboat folder on your own Drive (15 GB free). Lifeboat can't see your other files. Or save to a USB or second drive.

features.title: Clone to a new computer
features.body: Restore a backup from your PC onto your laptop and get the same themes, keys, Hermes and apps. Your screen layout is left alone.

features.title: Reinstalls your apps
features.body: After a restore, Lifeboat offers to reinstall every app that is missing, from the Arch repos and the AUR.

features.title: Automatic backups
features.body: Daily or weekly in the background. Keeps your last few backups and tidies away older ones.

steps.title: Install it
steps.body: Press GET in the Omarchy Store app, or run the one-line command above. Type your password when asked.

steps.title: Connect Google Drive
steps.body: Open Lifeboat (Super + Space, type Lifeboat), click Connect Google Drive and sign in. Or choose a local drive instead.

steps.title: Pick a passphrase and back up
steps.body: Choose a passphrase you will remember (write it down somewhere safe), then press Back up now. Turn on daily or weekly backups if you like.

faq.a: Yes, completely free and open source (MIT). Google Drive gives every account 15 GB free.

faq.q: Can Google or the Omarchy Store read my backup?
faq.a: No. Your backup is encrypted on your computer with your passphrase before it is uploaded. Without the passphrase it is unreadable, to anyone.

faq.q: What if I forget my passphrase?
faq.a: Then the backup can't be opened, by design. Keep it in a password manager or written down somewhere safe.

faq.q: Can Lifeboat see my other Google Drive files?
faq.a: No. It only asks Google for its own hidden app folder (the drive.appdata permission).

faq.q: What if a restore goes wrong?
faq.a: Lifeboat saves your current setup before restoring, so you can always go back.

faq.q: Does it back up my browser and big files?
faq.a: Browser profiles, caches and the large Hermes Python environment are skipped to keep backups small. Hermes rebuilds its environment by itself.

No. Lifeboat is free, open-source software provided as is. A backup can only be opened with its passphrase, restoring replaces files in your home folder (a safety copy is made first), and Lifeboat is not affiliated with Google or the Omarchy project. The authors and the Omarchy Store accept no liability for data loss or damage. Full text in the app under Settings → Legal.

description:
NEW IN 1.1.0
• A new look: life-ring logo, artwork, colour and a first-run disclaimer.

Lifeboat saves your whole Omarchy setup, so a broken update, a dead drive or a new computer never costs you your desktop again.

WHAT GETS SAVED
• Your Hermes agent: settings, API keys, memory, skills, sessions and scheduled jobs
• Your Omarchy desktop: Hyprland, Waybar, Walker, terminal, theme, keybindings and app settings
• Your shell and dotfiles (.bashrc, .zshrc, .gitconfig, ~/.local/bin) and your SSH keys
• A list of every app you installed, so they can all come back
• Any extra folders you add, like projects or documents

WHERE IT GOES
To a private, hidden folder on your own Google Drive (15 GB free with any Google account) and/or to a local or external drive. Lifeboat can only see its own folder, never your other Drive files. There's no Lifeboat account and no server of ours.

LOCKED WITH YOUR PASSPHRASE
Everything is packed, compressed and encrypted on your computer before it leaves (AES-256, 600,000-round key stretching). Only your passphrase opens it. Not Google, not us.

RESTORE OR CLONE
Pick a backup and restore it. Your current setup is saved first, so you can always go back. Or clone your PC onto a laptop: same themes, keybindings, Hermes and apps. Lifeboat then offers to reinstall any missing apps for you.

SET IT AND FORGET IT
Turn on daily or weekly automatic backups. Lifeboat keeps your last few and tidies away older ones.

Free and open source (MIT). Works from the app or the command line (lifeboat backup, lifeboat restore).

DISCLAIMER
Lifeboat is provided as is, without warranty. If you lose your passphrase the backup cannot be recovered. Restoring replaces files in your home folder (a safety copy is made first). Not affiliated with Google or the Omarchy project. The authors and the Omarchy Store accept no liability for data loss, downtime or damage. MIT licence.
